title: Refund eligibility
answer: Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if they are unused and in the original packaging.

title: Refund timeline
answer: Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Non-refundable items
answer: Gift cards and digital downloads cannot be refunded.

title: Damaged item refund
answer: If an item arrives damaged, report it within 48 hours with a photo to get a full refund or a replacement.

title: Return shipping cost
answer: Return shipping is free for damaged or wrong items. For other returns, a fee of Rs. 99 is deducted from the refund.

title: Refund status
answer: You can check your refund status under My Orders and then Refunds.

title: Standard delivery time
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch.

title: Express delivery
answer: Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days for an extra charge and is available in major cities.

title: Delayed delivery
answer: If your order has not arrived after 7 business days, contact support with your order number.

title: Shipping charges
answer: Shipping is free on orders above Rs. 999. Otherwise a flat fee of Rs. 49 applies.

title: Change delivery address
answer: You can change the delivery address from My Orders before the order is dispatched. After dispatch it cannot be changed.

title: Package shown as delivered but not received
answer: Please wait 24 hours and check with neighbours. If it still has not arrived, contact support with your order number.

title: International shipping
answer: We currently deliver only within India.

title: Order cancellation
answer: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are dispatched.

title: Order tracking
answer: A tracking link is sent by email and SMS once your order is dispatched.

title: Cancel after dispatch
answer: An order cannot be cancelled after dispatch. You can refuse the delivery or return the item after it arrives.

title: Change items in an order
answer: Items or sizes cannot be changed after the order is placed. Please cancel the order and place a new one.

title: Order confirmation email
answer: A confirmation email is sent within 10 minutes of placing an order. Check your spam folder, or contact support if it is missing.

title: Item out of stock
answer: If an item becomes unavailable after you order, we cancel it and refund the amount within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Accepted payment methods
answer: We accept credit cards, debit cards, UPI, net banking and cash on delivery. We do not accept cryptocurrency.

title: Failed payment
answer: If money was deducted but the order failed, the amount is returned automatically within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Charged twice
answer: If you were charged twice, send us both transaction IDs. The extra amount is refunded within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Invoice
answer: Your invoice is emailed after dispatch and can be downloaded from My Orders.

title: Cash on delivery
answer: Cash on delivery is available for orders up to Rs. 5,000 with a fee of Rs. 30.

title: EMI option
answer: EMI is available on credit card orders above Rs. 3,000.

title: Promo codes
answer: One promo code can be used per order. Codes cannot be combined and are applied at checkout.

title: Password reset
answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the login page to receive a reset email.

title: Change email or phone
answer: Go to Settings and then Profile to change your email or phone number. You will need to verify it with an OTP.

title: Delete account
answer: Go to Settings, then Privacy, then Delete Account. Deletion is permanent and is completed within 7 days.

title: Account locked
answer: After 5 wrong password attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Resetting your password unlocks it.

title: Create an account
answer: Sign up with your email or phone number and verify it with an OTP.

title: Update saved address
answer: Add or edit addresses under My Account and then Addresses.

title: Where is my order
answer: You can see where your order is under My Orders and then Track Order. A tracking link is also sent by email and SMS once it is dispatched.

title: Track my parcel
answer: Track your parcel using the link in your dispatch email or SMS, or under My Orders and then Track Order. Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear.

title: Order not received yet
answer: If you have not received your parcel within the delivery estimate, check the tracking link first. If there is no update for 3 days, or the delivery is delayed beyond 7 business days, contact support with your order number.

title: Money back for a cancelled order
answer: If you cancel an order that was already paid, the money is returned to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Where is my refund
answer: If your refund has not arrived within 7 business days, check My Orders and then Refunds, or contact support with your order number.

title: Login problems
answer: If you cannot log in, check your email and password or use Forgot Password. If the account is locked, wait 30 minutes.
